title: Manager, Transmission Market Analytics
location_raw: Chicago, IL; Houston, TX; Dallas, TX
description:
LRE (Leeward Renewable Energy) is forging an American energy future with integrity, innovation, and positive impact. Born in Texas in 2003, we own and operate over 30 utility-scale wind, solar, and energy storage projects in local communities across the United States, totaling 4 gigawatts (GW) of generating capacity.

LRE continues to help meet increased U.S. energy demand through our robust pipeline of new projects every year. Domestic jobs and manufacturing are fundamental to our full-lifecycle approach to projects, along with a long-term ownership model and a company culture dedicated to our community partners and protecting the natural environment.
Job Summary:
The Manager, Transmission Market Analytics (P4) acts as a technical expert in the simulation of the energy market and as an analyst of key metrics including LMP, congestion, nodal LMP Forecasts, basis and curtailment. He or she will assist the team in evaluating acquisition opportunities, determine optimal locations for the placement of renewable energy projects, identify transmission service availability and review independent third-party studies related to potential commercial transactions through analysis of energy markets.

The Manager will work with internal and external stakeholders to review and track potential impacts to the future transmission system including interconnection queue positions, generator retirement announcements, transmission plans, load growth, regulatory actions and policy changes.
This position requires excellent communication and collaboration skills as well as the ability to work well under pressure, multi-task, and shift priorities on the go. The successful candidate will be well organized, comfortable in a dynamic environment, have strong attention to detail, and can synthesize and conceptualize complex ideas. A passion for renewable energy is a plus.

Essential Functions:

- Support the Transmission group with the development of strategic and tactical plans.

- Provide advice and recommendations about critical transmission issues related to potential commercial power transactions, planning issues and real-time operational issues.

- Keep abreast of developments across the power & renewables industry

- Perform quantitative research, econometric analysis and forecasting on power and fuel markets utilizing internal models and contribute to the development of company’s market analytics platform (Zonal, Long Term Capacity Expansion and Nodal models)

- Running SCED analysis for operating and development projects, including ad hoc sensitivity analyses, and providing direct guidance and support to the Development, and Commercial groups.

- Develop and refine process controls and quality assurance methods to benchmark and validate power system and SCED models (including Dayzer, PROMOD and similar platforms) and ensure model accuracy.

- Manage and maintain power system modeling information databases.

- Training others in the use of SCED (PROMOD/Encompass/Dayzer) and supporting software.

- Support tax equity and cash equity transactions on matters related to congestion and curtailment that arise during financing transactions

- Identifying unique transmission solutions for reliability and/or economic constraints in various planning regions.

- Testify before regulatory agencies regarding transmission & interconnection matters

- Represent Leeward and maintain productive relationships with assigned utilities, ISOs, industry groups, regulators and other stakeholders in assigned geographic areas on issues related to transmission and interconnection.

- Participate in stakeholder forums to understand industry concerns and direction with respect to grid connected renewable resources and provide leadership in such forums on issues related to development of Leeward projects.

- Support Government Affairs in the development of renewable resource policies

- Assist and support Transmission Interconnection and Network Staff as needed

- Prepare and submit interconnection requests

- Coordinate with external consultants supporting Leeward’s effort

- Oversee utility interconnection studies so they are reasonable and timely

- Negotiate utility interconnection agreements, affected system agreements and engineering and procurement agreements

- Develop and negotiate business arrangements to remove obstacles to project interconnections and reduce interconnection costs

Qualifications:

- 6-8+ years' experience in transmission planning or economic modeling using PROMOD, Encompass, Plexos, Gridview, Dayzer, Aurora or other market simulation tools.

- Proficient in transmission system planning, transmission construction and operation topics.

- Experience in detailed economic modeling of transmission networks, thermal and renewable generators, experience in wholesale power markets and congestion analytics.

- Ability to establish strong working relationships with utilities, ISOs and industry representatives.

- Proficient in public speaking, presentation skills, explaining complex technical topics and writing of technical reports.

- Strong collaboration and problem-solving skills, with solid understanding of transmission shift factors, statistics, probabilistic analysis, and advanced engineering principles.

- Working knowledge of databases including MS Access, MySQL, SQL Server strongly preferred.

- Working knowledge of automation scripts such as VB, VB.net and python for development of automation modules is preferred.

- Proficient use of all Microsoft Office suite programs

Please Note: This is an in-office role, requiring on site presence in our office a minimum of three days per week with hybrid flexibility of working remotely two days per week, subject to manager and policy approval. #LIHybrid

LRE considers several factors when determining compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. In compliance with the Illinois Equal Pay Act, the salary range for the Manager, Transmission Market Analytics is between $124,000 to $172,000 annually. Compensation is set within the range based on each candidate’s background, with the potential to grow as responsibilities and experience increase. This position also includes a comprehensive benefits package, including a 401(k)-retirement plan, health, dental, vision, and life insurance. For a complete overview of our benefits, please visit:  https://www.lreus.com/about-us/careers/

Physical Demands:

- This position will travel 20% of time

- Position will require sitting for long periods of time as well as occasionally lifting up to twenty-pound boxes.

Applicants must have current authorization to work for any employer in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for an employment visa now or in the future . Employer visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

title: Power Trading Analyst
description:
LRE (Leeward Renewable Energy) is forging an American energy future with integrity, innovation, and positive impact. Born in Texas in 2003, we own and operate over 30 utility-scale wind, solar, and energy storage projects in local communities across the United States, totaling 4 gigawatts (GW) of generating capacity.

LRE continues to help meet increased U.S. energy demand through our robust pipeline of new projects every year. Domestic jobs and manufacturing are fundamental to our full-lifecycle approach to projects, along with a long-term ownership model and a company culture dedicated to our community partners and protecting the natural environment.
Responsibilities:

- Conduct thorough short- and long-term market analysis, leveraging large datasets to inform trading decisions and identify potential risks and opportunities.

- Develop, maintain, and enhance forecasting models for pricing, congestion, system load, and other market-related factors using Excel, Python, SQL, and other relevant tools.

- Generate and assess various forward-looking scenarios, including localized congestion and abnormal market events, to create edge case strategies.

-  Monitor real-time market conditions, identify emerging patterns, and provide actionable insights and recommendations to traders.

- Work closely with traders, offering up-to-date market insights, and providing backup support by transacting, monitoring positions, and submitting trades on weekends when required.

- Prepare and deliver detailed market analysis reports or dashboards, ensuring that traders have the most relevant and accurate information.

- Gather, clean, and manage extensive datasets, ensuring the integrity and accuracy of data used in models and analysis.

- Create and maintain tools, models, and reports to support trading activities utilizing Excel, SQL, Python, and other external APIs.

- Offer strategic trade recommendations based on a deep understanding of market fundamentals and analytics, contributing to the trading desk's overall performance.

- Support market operations.

- Schedule Assets, virtual trading, and PTPs with objective of optimizing DA/RT, Basis and revenue outcomes.

- Track and analyze weather forecasts, determine impact to LRE portfolio and develop actionable trading strategies.

- undefined

- Support Origination and Development, supplying long-term price forecasts and scenario analysis.

Qualifications:

- 2-4 years of experience as an Analyst or Junior Trader on a Power Trading desk, with a proven track record in transactional support and market analysis.

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.

- Proficiency in Python, SQL, Excel (including VBA) strongly recommended , Tableau, and power flow modeling tools such as Pro-Mod and Power World.

- Strong understanding of transmission grids, power flows, virtual trading, and FTR auctions, particularly across PJM, ERCOT, and CAISO.

- Critical thinker with strong analytical abilities, capable of identifying risk mitigation strategies and enhancing revenue through data-driven decisions.

- Effective communicator with the ability to translate complex analytical findings into actionable insights for traders.

- Ability to work under pressure, think creatively, and provide weekend support when needed.

- Position will require sitting for long periods of time as well as occasionally lifting up to twenty-pound boxes

title: Development Engineering Manager
description:
LRE (Leeward Renewable Energy) is forging an American energy future with integrity, innovation, and positive impact. Born in Texas in 2003, we own and operate over 30 utility-scale wind, solar, and energy storage projects in local communities across the United States, totaling 4 gigawatts (GW) of generating capacity.

LRE continues to help meet increased U.S. energy demand through our robust pipeline of new projects every year. Domestic jobs and manufacturing are fundamental to our full-lifecycle approach to projects, along with a long-term ownership model and a company culture dedicated to our community partners and protecting the natural environment.
Job Summary:
The Manager of Development Engineering reports to the Director of Project Engineering and will provide managerial oversight and at times hands on work related to the design and engineering aspects of wind, solar, and energy storage projects from mid-stage development through the handoff to project execution.  This position will interface with development, origination, estimating, procurement, preconstruction, and other engineering subject matter experts to ensure the development engineering processes are completed smoothly and efficiently.  The position requires experience with development, design, and construction of utility scale renewable energy projects.

Responsibilities:

- Support the development of a zero incident Leeward safety culture.

- Provide leadership to Leeward’s project development engineering function relating to the development of all new wind, solar, and energy storage projects.

- Excellent cross-functional teamwork, especially with Leeward’s Development team on project development efforts and with Leeward’s Preconstruction team to ensure successful, proper design of safe and reliable projects

- Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing development engineering team

- Actively weigh the consequences of all preliminary designs, engineering assumptions, and site evaluations from all the disciplines involved in the project to ensure project is set up successfully for execution

- Manage the completion of preliminary engineering studies, layouts, and energy estimates to support the development and permitting process as well as offtake marketing

- Provide accurate inputs and assumptions of risk for estimator bid inputs and financial models

- Participate in cost estimate and bid deep dive review meetings with preconstruction team

- Set up and improve processes for development engineering work by evaluating new technologies/software, editing task guidebooks, and working cross functionally to align with other departments

- Assure prioritization and the timely completion of multiple development engineering tasks in support of the project build plan and early development efforts

- Responsible for maintaining clear and concise communications, keeping accurate records, distributing progress reports and thorough documentation throughout all phases of the project and incorporating into the Leeward Document Management System

- Provide leadership in lessons learned by taking action to correct items before recurrence and proactively updating processes and role guidebooks.

- Makes effective use of resources to achieve an optimal balance of cost and risk in the execution and delivery of renewable energy projects

- Effectively enlists leadership from all levels of the cross functional organization to achieve common vision, goals and objectives for the project(s)

- Demonstrates a sense of urgency in the face of important issues and reaching timely decisions where necessary to ensure minimal impact on project schedule and costs

Qualifications:

- Bachelor of Science in Engineering from an accredited university and a minimum of (8) years of experience in engineering and/or construction of power generation facilities and/or electrical systems.

- A minimum of two (2) years of experience in management or leadership role with engineering, construction/project management of wind/solar/storage projects.  A Professional Engineering Registration (PE) is highly desirable.

- Proficient in some of the following: AutoCAD, PVsyst, PlantPredict, Openwind, and other automated layout/optimization tools.

- Understanding of project development and permitting processes

- Knowledge of project commercial issues and project financial analysis

- Strong project management skills

- Proficient knowledge of engineering economics and optimization process

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

- Organized with the ability to simultaneously oversee multiple development projects

- Well-developed and professional interpersonal skills; ability to interact effectively with people at all levels of the organization, as well as outside customers and vendors

- Proficient use of all Microsoft Office Suite programs

- Ability to operate a motor vehicle and possession of a valid driver's license

Physical Demands:

- Position will require sitting for long periods of time

- Occasionally lifting up to twenty-pound boxes

- Willingness and ability to travel at least 25% of time

Please Note:  This is an in-office role, requiring on site presence in our office a minimum of three days per week with hybrid flexibility of working remotely two days per week, subject to manager and policy approval. #LIHybrid
